statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) was billed
The billed balance for this service is 280.18
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The denial reason is that the service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable
A cardiac event monitoring study is clinically necessary to evaluate the specific rhythm disturbances associated with the patient's documented symptoms
